name: aevum
description: Check whether any trader, trading bot or AI agent has a real record, and prepare market calls that people lock in their own wallet on Aevum's site.

interface.longDescription:
Anyone can claim they called it. Aevum shows who actually did.

Ask ChatGPT to check any wallet's record on Aevum: every market call it locked on Ethereum before the market moved, graded afterwards on public prices, right or wrong, with a certificate anyone can re-check. Look up a Polymarket or Hyperliquid wallet's hot week next to its whole history, see what stablecoin payouts a prop firm's payout wallet has actually sent, check who runs an AI trading agent and whether its name is verified, and get a ready-to-send message asking a signal seller to prove their record before you pay.

You can also turn your own market view into an exact call. ChatGPT checks it against the live price and shows a card with the exact text, how it will be graded and a button that opens app.aevumprotocol.io, where you review it and lock it in your own wallet. Nothing is signed or paid in the chat, and Aevum never signs for anyone.

Calls are not trades: no money is won or lost on a call, and a record is not investment advice. No sign-up and no API key. Aevum works the same for people, trading bots and AI agents.

positive.description: Look up a wallet's Aevum record (calls locked on Ethereum and graded on public prices).
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the wallet's locked calls with verified, running and right/wrong counts, and links to its public record page on app.aevumprotocol.io.

positive.description: Check whether a Polymarket wallet's hot week matches its whole history (public Polymarket data, read-only).
positive.prompt: Use Aevum to check Polymarket wallet 0xf0318c32136c2db7fec88b84869aee6a1106c80c. Is it good or just lucky this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows this week vs last 30 days vs all-time results, max drawdown and position stats, and notes that a hot week isn't a track record.

positive.description: Check a Hyperliquid wallet's week next to its whole record (public Hyperliquid data, read-only).
positive.prompt: Use Aevum to check Hyperliquid wallet 0xdfc24b077bc1425ad1dea75bcb6f8158e10df303.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows this week, last 30 days and all-time results and max drawdown, with a link to the full check.

positive.description: Independently re-grade a published Aevum certificate from public prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verdict MATCH with the reason (Aevum's recorded result follows from the published data).

positive.description: Draft a market call and open it on Aevum's site to lock it in the person's own wallet. Nothing is signed or paid in ChatGPT.
positive.prompt: Help me lock a call that BTC is higher in 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Lock card with the exact call (BTC higher in 7 days), how it is graded, the live BTC price, the 7-day window and the 0.001 ETH refundable deposit. The button opens app.aevumprotocol.io/lock with the call filled in.

negative.description: A plain price quote is a general market question. Aevum checks records and drafts calls; it is not a price feed, so it should not be used here.
negative.prompt: What's the price of Bitcoin right now?

negative.description: Asking for investment advice. Aevum does not give buy or sell recommendations, so it should not be used; the model should answer normally without Aevum.
negative.prompt: Should I buy ETH this week?

negative.description: Asking to place a bet or trade. Aevum never places bets, orders or trades and never moves money, so it should not be triggered.
negative.prompt: Place a $500 bet on Polymarket for me that the Fed cuts rates in December.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. Nothing is sold, paid or signed in ChatGPT. draft_call returns a link to app.aevumprotocol.io where the person can lock a market call in their own wallet with a 0.001 ETH refundable deposit (returned when the call is graded); it is not a purchase of goods, credits or tokens.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read-only checks of trading records (Aevum calls locked on Ethereum and graded on public prices), Polymarket and Hyperliquid wallet history, prop firm payout wallets and AI agent identities, plus draft_call, which shows a card linking to app.aevumprotocol.io where the person locks the call in their own wallet. Nothing is signed or paid in ChatGPT.
